Implemented transaction handling for Changelist list_editable processing in `django/contrib/admin/options.py`.

Change made in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view`: the loop that saves each changed form during POSTed bulk-edit (`list_editable`) processing is now wrapped in `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`. This ensures all list_editable object saves, related saves, and change-log writes commit atomically, preventing partial/unexpected database states if an error occurs mid-processing. `transaction` and `router` were already imported.

Verification: scoped_tests public regression selection (`admin_changelist`) passed — 74 tests ran, 0 failures.
